description: Screen food ingredients against the public private-label ingredient rules of 7 US retailers: Trader Joe's (TJ), Whole Foods Market (WFM), Kroger Simple Truth (ST), Walmart (WMT), Sam's Club (SAM), Aldi (ALDI) and Sprouts (SPR). Covers about 54 ingredients and classes (synthetic colors, high-intensity sweeteners, preservatives, emulsifiers, fats, flavors). Statuses: BANNED, BANNED_BY_PRINCIPLE, ALLOWED_NAMED, CONDITIONAL, NOT_LISTED (not the same as approved), UNVERIFIED, CONFIRM_WITH_BUYER. Public lists are not full specifications: always confirm with the buyer.

ingredients.description: Ingredient names as on a label, e.g. ['sucralose', 'Red 40', 'sodium benzoate'].

retailers.description: Optional subset of retailer codes. Default: all 7.

name: check_retailer_ingredients
title: Check ingredients against US retailer private-label rules
